B3.prompt: Split this mahjong tile into three layers. Layer 1: the plain background. Layer 2: the ceramic tile body with its gold border and bevel. Layer 3: only the painted glyph strokes on a fully transparent background, with no tile surface, no border and no shadow. Keep the exact shapes, colours and proportions of the glyph.
